mapper.select: SELECT id, shop_id, category_id, tag_id, name, sub_title, brand, description, image, sales_mode, listing_status, sales_price, market_price, product_code, stock, weight, volume, create_time, update_time FROM products WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND listing_status = 1 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, shop_id, category_id, tag_id, name, sub_title, brand, description, image, body, sales_mode, listing_status, sales_price, market_price, product_code, stock, weight, volume, create_time, update_time FROM products WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId}

SELECT id, shop_id, category_id, tag_id, name, sub_title, brand, description, image, sales_mode, listing_status, sales_price, market_price, product_code, stock, weight, volume, create_time, update_time FROM products WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND listing_status = 1 AND id IN
#{id}

SELECT p.id, p.shop_id, p.category_id, p.tag_id, p.name, p.sub_title, p.brand, p.description, p.image, p.sales_mode, p.listing_status, p.sales_price, p.market_price, p.product_code, p.stock, p.weight, p.volume, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.shop_id = #{shopId} AND p.listing_status = 1 AND c.parent_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY p.id ASC

SELECT id, shop_id, category_id, tag_id, name, sub_title, brand, description, image, sales_mode, listing_status, sales_price, market_price, product_code, stock, weight, volume, create_time, update_time FROM products WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND listing_status = 1 AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR sub_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, shop_id, category_id, tag_id, name, sub_title, brand, description, image, body, sales_mode, listing_status, sales_price, market_price, cost_price, product_code, stock, weight, volume, create_time, update_time FROM products WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (shop_id, category_id, tag_id, name, sub_title, brand, description, image, body, sales_mode, listing_status, sales_price, market_price, cost_price, product_code, stock, weight, volume, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{shopId}, #{categoryId}, #{tagId}, #{name}, #{subTitle}, #{brand}, #{description}, #{image}, #{body}, #{salesMode}, #{listingStatus}, #{salesPrice}, #{marketPrice}, #{costPrice}, #{productCode}, #{stock}, #{weight}, #{volume}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM products WHERE id = #{id} AND shop_id = #{shopId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT brand FROM products WHERE shop_id = #{shopId} AND brand IS NOT NULL AND brand != '' ORDER BY brand ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(stock), 0) AS SIGNED) AS total_stock, COALESCE(SUM(sales_price * stock), 0) AS total_value FROM products WHERE shop_id = #{shopId}
